environment: isolated Debian 12 QEMU TCG aaPanel 8.0.7 guest; non-production
assurance_limits: FPM binary/runtime config inspection and HTTP routing were observed in one versioned lab combination; not a cross-version compatibility guarantee.
Preview remains file/default based. It does not query the live FPM master process on each request or claim that the daemon has reloaded its latest file.
Both test sites targeted one installed versioned [www] pool; no per-site FPM pool was configured.
No WP Toolkit automation or cross-tool pool reset was reproduced. A normal second native website creation left the FPM config hash unchanged.
Site deletion used the native backend path=0 plus guarded test root cleanup, not an authenticated browser UI test.
Lab-only changes: no production deployment, plugin Apply, PHP-FPM reload, version migration, or policy enforcement.
runtime_probe_scope: Only the read-only helper source from the stated commit was copied to the isolated guest. The later malformed-line parser fix was checked by source tests, not rerun in the guest.
